output_text: "A memorial plaque honoring 27 local people who died fighting in the Spanish Civil War has been unveiled at the Unite building in Islington, named after trade unionist Jack Jones, who survived the conflict. Local historian Danny Payne notes that 30 people from Merseyside are believed to have died, traveling secretly to fight due to the UK government's ban on it. The plaque now has a permanent home at Jack Jones, fittingly located in a building named after the trade union leader."
